objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: No Test-Path collision check followed by WriteAllText/Set-Content exists for OutputPath.
Output creation uses FileMode.CreateNew and never overwrites an existing file.
No parent directory is auto-created; nonexistent parent causes clear failure.
Review packet contains ci_evidence.status=PENDING with null run/result fields until CI actually passes.
Review packet contains no claim that regression tests already passed or verified the corrections.
All prior Astra Review #1 fixes remain intact.
retry_reason: Worker run 37099621392 completed successfully, but static gate found the candidate still violates the explicit atomic create-new requirement and the review packet falsely claims regression verification before CI has run. Correct these before PR resubmission.
orchestrator_corrections: Replace the OutputPath implementation entirely. Do NOT use Test-Path followed by WriteAllText/Set-Content. Use [System.IO.FileStream]::new($OutputPath,[System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[System.IO.FileAccess]::Write,[System.IO.FileShare]::None), then a UTF-8 StreamWriter over that stream, write the JSON, flush, and dispose in finally. If the file exists, FileMode.CreateNew must throw and the script must return non-zero with a clear collision error. Do not pre-create parent directories: if the parent does not exist, fail clearly rather than modifying the filesystem beyond the explicitly requested new report file.
The audit tool is allowed to create ONLY the explicitly requested new report file. It must not create parent directories, temp directories, or any other local artifacts.

Change review packet notes. It MUST NOT say the P1/P2 issues are 'fully addressed and verified against regression test suites' before the PR regression workflow has actually passed. State instead: 'Corrections implemented; regression evidence pending CI on corrected PR head.'

Review packet must include a machine-readable ci_evidence object with status=PENDING, workflow=.github/workflows/pc_cleanup_audit_regression.yml, run_id=null, tested_commit=null, powershell_version=null, result=null.

Keep all prior safe changes: PowerShell 7 guard, ActiveProjectRoot/candidate-root validation, ErrorAction Stop enumeration, exact normalized provenance matching, case-insensitive deduplication, UTC mtime, Google Drive memory, zero spend, audit-only.
Do not claim Astra approval or CI PASS.
Use exact model gemini-3.5-flash-lite in all provenance-bearing names/metadata.
